# Sayamwar Hall & Homestay

> Sayamwar Hall & Homestay is a banquet hall, wedding venue, and homestay in Danapur, Patna, Bihar, India. It hosts weddings, receptions, birthday parties, engagement/ring ceremonies, and corporate events in a fully air-conditioned hall for 200–300 guests, and offers on-site AC and non-AC guest rooms.

## Key facts

- Location: Gola Road, Adarsh Vihar Colony, Lane Number 5, near T Point, beside Hotel King Regency, Danapur, Patna, Bihar 801503, India
- Distance: 5 minutes from Danapur Railway Station; ~20–25 minutes from Patna Junction; ~25–30 minutes from Patna Airport (Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 7646028228 (also 7070486987)
- Email: care@sayamwar.com
- Hours: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Google rating: 4.8 out of 5 (17+ reviews)
- Capacity: 200–300 guests, fully air-conditioned hall
- Rooms: On-site homestay — Standard (₹1,500/night), Deluxe AC (₹1,800/night), Premium Suite (₹2,500/night)
- Catering: In-house, three menu tiers — Shagun (₹999/plate veg), Vivah (₹1,199/plate veg), Swayamvar (₹1,399/plate veg); non-veg available
- Pricing: Birthday/engagement packages from ₹85,000; wedding packages from ₹1,51,000; reception packages from ₹1,00,000
- What's included in packages: stage and lawn decoration, mandap, DJ and sound system, security/bouncer, selfie point, night coffee, parking, and (for weddings) 2–6 on-site rooms
- Areas served: Patna and Danapur, including guests from Bailey Road, Saguna More, Khagaul, and Phulwari Sharif (typically 15–25 minutes away)
